items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember any of these Henry Fillmore trombone pieces? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Never played any of it, no.

ctx.x: See, he had, since he had the stroke in the head. He had a stroke of the head two years ago. And he's, uh, mind don't uh, you know, just keep it going all the time. You just gotta stop to think of what it is and what it ain't. He gets tired. Yeah, yeah. The doctor said the brain had been injured and he didn't know to what extent. That's why sometimes he can remember and sometimes he doesn't.
Do you remember any of these Henry Fillmore trombone pieces? Like, Lassus' trombone, Miss Trombone? No, I never played none of that stuff. Never played none of that stuff.
Never played any of it, no.
